description: This file defines the GrainCancellationToken class, an abstraction similar to CancellationToken that can be sent between grains in Orleans. It manages cancellation tokens, references to remote grains, and supports cancellation and disposal.

classes.name: GrainCancellationToken
classes.description: A class representing a cancellation token that can be sent between grains, supporting cancellation, subscription to grain references, and disposal.

methods.name: Cancel
methods.description: Cancels the token, either directly or via the runtime if available.

methods.name: AddGrainReference
methods.description: Adds a grain reference to be notified of cancellation.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Disposes the underlying cancellation token source.
